long_biography.plain_text:
Private-equity investor Angus Littlejohn studied economics at the University of Pennsylvania before joining S.G. Warburg in London as a corporate finance associate. He later pursued businesses in mining, aviation and equipment leasing, then specialised in leveraged buyouts as a managing director at Quadrex Securities.

His public commitments extend to education and ocean conservation. With Leslie Littlejohn and their son Angus III, he supported a Vanderbilt programme pairing undergraduates with faculty researchers. He has also served on Ocean Exchange's board, while his family supports its work helping businesses develop and commercialise technologies for healthier oceans.
long_biography.html:
Private-equity investor Angus Littlejohn studied economics at the University of Pennsylvania before joining S.G. Warburg in London as a corporate finance associate. He later pursued businesses in mining, aviation and equipment leasing, then specialised in leveraged buyouts as a managing director at Quadrex Securities.

His public commitments extend to education and ocean conservation. With Leslie Littlejohn and their son Angus III, he supported a Vanderbilt programme pairing undergraduates with faculty researchers. He has also served on Ocean Exchange's board, while his family supports its work helping businesses develop and commercialise technologies for healthier oceans.
